messages:
maria: Heads-up — after flipping the epilogue lane-merge flag on master I see a consistent 6-12% tail latency regression for long sequences (seq=2048, batch=1). Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: Seen a tiny dip on packed-qkv too. Do you have the bench id/commit? :thinking_face:
bench-bot: run_id: merged-epilogue-20260317-01, commit: a1b2c3d, config: model=bloom-7b, seq=2048, batch=1, kernels=[flash, packed-qkv, epilogue-merge=on], p50=1100 tok/s, p95=980 tok/s, p99=760 tok/s (baseline before flip: p99=820 tok/s)
junaid: Quick note: flamegraphs show a jump in warp-stall and memory-copy time in the epilogue path when lane-merge is enabled — looks like coalescing got worse for certain KV page alignments. Could be divergence from the lane-merge logic.
maria: Here's the quick profiling command I used:```nvprof --kernels "*epilogue*" --csv --log-file epilog-prof.csv ./bench --model bloom-7b --seq 2048 --batch 1```Kernel list extracted: epilogue_merge_kernel, qkv_pack_kernel, bias_rope_fuse_kernel
alexr: Important distinction: this is not qkv packing itself, it's the additional per-lane shuffle introduced by epilogue-lane-merge. Bias/rope fusion tacks on more strided loads. Try toggling bias/rope fusion only.
liyah: Also check the kernel chooser heuristics — we recently changed the threshold that routes >=512 seq to the paged-kv path. If lane-merge changes perf characteristics, the chooser might now pick a suboptimal kernel for those inputs. See `kernel_chooser.cc` heuristic: `if (seq >= 512 && kv_pages > 4) choose_paged_kv();`
kevin: I ran A/B: bias/rope fusion off, epilogue_merge on -> p99 back to baseline but p50 slightly worse for short sequences. So bias/rope fusion seems to interact with lane-merge.
maria: Proposed path forward: (1) add a micro-heuristic in chooser to prefer non-fused-epilogue for seq>1024 & batch<=2 when epilogue_lane_merge is enabled, (2) instrument more perf counters (L1 hit rate, sm_efficiency) in traces, (3) add a runtime flag so Dedicated customers can opt-in. Thoughts?
junaid: SGTM. Also suggest we add a small synthetic test that exercises unaligned KV page offsets — we can fuzz page offsets and measure memcpy/coalesce metrics.
bench-bot: quick new run: merged-epilogue-rollback-test, epilogue_merge=off, seq=2048, batch=1 -> p99=825 tok/s (matches baseline).
deploy-bot: We can gate chooser tweak behind a feature flag and roll out to 10% canary. I can add rollout config in console if PR includes flag.
maria: @kevin @junaid can one of you put up a small PR with chooser tweak + extra trace counters? I'll open an issue attaching the flamegraphs and bench ids. Thanks! :thumbsup:
